brand_story: Una piattaforma dedicata alle associazioni di volontariato per gestire la presenza sul territorio, coordinare i turni di 2 ore e garantire la composizione ideale di genere (almeno 1 Uomo e almeno 2 Donne su 3 volontari) con chiarezza visiva immediata e rispetto umano.

entry_surfaces./: mobile-first clean dashboard shell with persistent bottom navigation and active shift highlight
entry_surfaces./login: centered branded authentication card on soft slate background with volunteer and admin preset shortcuts
entry_surfaces./register: structured registration card with gender selection, phone validation, and instant account activation

motion.transitions: transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease
motion.animations: staggered fade-up for shift cards, soft spring dialog animations, smooth badge pulse on pending gender requirement

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for body and badge text, verified against backgrounds)
accessibility.mobile_touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all buttons and interactive slots
accessibility.aria_labels: Explicit aria-labels on shift status indicators, postazione filters, and volunteer slot tags

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 3 default stations (Postazione A, Postazione B, Postazione C) with clear color coding: Emerald Green for A, Indigo for B, Amber/Warm for C.

Enforce the 3-volunteer shift rule strictly: each 2-hour shift has 3 slots, requiring at least 1 Uomo and at least 2 Donne. Block registrations that would violate this ratio and show descriptive status chips (e.g. 'Serve 1 Donna', 'Serve 1 Uomo', 'Completo').
Prevent volunteer overlapping: a volunteer cannot register for overlapping time slots across different stations.
Provide two primary shift views: Giornaliera (Day timeline) and Settimanale (Week grid/cards) with Postazione filter pills.
Implement full Admin management: create/edit/delete shifts, volunteer directory (anagrafica), custom station names in Configurazione, and Bacheca Avvisi (announcement board).
Volunteers can view available shifts, register with one tap, cancel their registration, update their profile (Genere Uomo/Donna, Nome, Cognome, Telefono), and read the Bacheca.
Design mobile-first with a bottom navigation bar for quick access (Turni, Bacheca, Mio Profilo / Admin Panel) and responsive desktop sidebar layout.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive buttons, inputs, filter tabs, registration buttons, and shift cards for testing reliability.

component_structure.ShiftCard: Displays time interval, station tag with color, 3 volunteer slots with gender icons, status badge, and action button (Iscriviti / Annulla Iscrizione)
component_structure.ShiftFilterBar: Segmented tabs for Day/Week view and filter pills for Stations A/B/C
component_structure.BachecaFeed: Announcements card list with pinned alerts, timestamp, and author badge
component_structure.AdminShiftModal: Modal for creating/editing 2-hour slot with station, date, and time selector
component_structure.StationConfigPanel: Admin panel to rename stations A, B, C and manage standard slot templates
component_structure.VolunteerDirectory: Searchable table/cards of registered volunteers with gender tag, phone number, and shift count
